description: Search medical device manufacturers by company name, optionally in one country, with offset paging. Returns up to 20 companies per page with slug, page URL and country, the total and next_offset. Use when a company is named or looked for. Do not use to find devices (use search_devices, which also filters by manufacturer name). Pass a slug to get_manufacturer for the company record. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

country.description: Only manufacturers registered with this country in a registry (EUDAMED or FDA address): a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. e.g. DE, US, NL. Default: all countries.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

query.description: Words of the company name, 2 to 100 characters. e.g. "philips", "B. Braun"

name: search_manufacturers
title: Search manufacturers
